items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Louis Jordan was the first so-called Rock group, to me, that ever existed. It was very popular. Louis Jordan was ahead of his time.

ctx.x: Joe Johnson was the drummer. Then we had Jordan on trombone. We had U.S. Scott, U.S. "Shorty" Scott on alto. Fats Green...
